newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CESI INDEX ENDS AT A NEW HIGH OF 1,739.06 PTS.
newsitem.headline: CESI INDEX ENDS AT A NEW HIGH OF 1,739.06 PTS.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index firmed 0.74 percent or 12.74 points to finish at a new high of 1,739.06 points, a new record high, on Friday, the Budapest Stock Exchange said.
The index, which has been published since February 1, 1996, reflects trends of 73 shares on the Budapest, Prague, Warsaw, Bratislava and Ljubljana bourses.
